theme_strategy.description: Industrial Technical Dashboard. Follows ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST. Avoid soft gradients, glossy surfaces, and 'AI-slop'. Emphasize data density, clear hierarchy, and stark structural components.
theme_strategy.shadows: None. Use 1px borders to separate elements.

headings.usage: Page titles, card headers, primary KPIs.

data_metrics.usage: Numerical KPIs, chart labels, data tables, stock quantities.

layouts.general: Collapsible left sidebar for main navigation (Menu, Cek & Report, Master Data). Top header for Breadcrumbs, Language Switcher (ID/EN), User Profile.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B (High Density Grid). Base grid `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4`. Tight gaps `gap-4`. Top row for 4 core KPIs. Middle row for main Line/Bar chart (`col-span-3`) and a supporting donut/metric (`col-span-1`). Bottom row for recent exceptions/tables.
layouts.forms: Grid-based modular forms (Bento style). Dense spacing. Inputs have crisp 1px borders.
layouts.tables: Dense layout, no extra whitespace. Right-align numerical data. Use monospaced font for all numbers.

components_instructions.cards: Go cardless or use flat, rectangular cards with 1px border. DO NOT use soft shadows. E.g., `border border-zinc-200 bg-white rounded-sm` (or dark equivalent).
components_instructions.buttons: Sharp corners (`rounded-sm`), high contrast. Primary actions are solid blue, secondary actions are outline.
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn `Input`, `Select`, `Form`. Keep form labels small and uppercase (`text-xs uppercase tracking-widest`).
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn if available). Minimal axes, stark contrast lines. No soft gradient fills under line charts, keep it technical.
components_instructions.navigation: Sidebar must have active states with distinct left-border highlight. Must support Admin vs User views.
components_instructions.login: Split screen layout. Left: Hero image (factory background) with dark overlay (`bg-black/50`). Right: Dense login form (JWT credentials + Google Auth Button).

login_background.description: Modern industrial factory manufacturing plant interior

key_features_to_implement: Authentication (JWT + Google Auth) with User vs Admin roles.
Dashboard: Production reports, KPI metrics, dynamic charts.
Data Entry: Production, Stock, Operational Hours, GI/GR.
Reports: Stock Check, PDF/Excel Exports (using appropriate JS libraries like jspdf/xlsx).
testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, tabs, export buttons) MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='export-pdf-button'`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do NOT use purple or random gradients.
Implement a robust layout with Sidebar Navigation, Topbar, and a Main Content area.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively, overriding default border-radius to `rounded-sm`.
Ensure the data visualizations (charts) are readable with high contrast.
Do not center-align the main app container; use a full-width dashboard layout.
Include hover states and micro-animations for all buttons and interactive rows, but keep them subtle and technical (e.g., fast transitions, no bounce).
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
